notes.text: When there is a pair of checkboxes, one is for when you find the diagram, and the other is for when you actually craft it.

Viper Venomous Silver Sword can only be found during Whatsoever a Man Soweth and you will find it stuck in a stone in Gaunter's world. You do not find a diagram, but the actual sword in this situation.
